releases.notes:
# Consistency+ 0.4.0
We welcome you guys to our biggest update yet
Disclaimer: This may have some bad loading times for a few people., we apologize, and are trying to find a fix, though we might not find one til 1.0.0.

## Additions
### Calcite, Tuff, Dripstone, Deepslate, Obsidian, Crying Obsidian, Terracotta, and Concrete
These blocks have all gotten the full Consistency+ Treatment! We are glad to see these new blocks in action

### Tiles
With the introduction of tiles into vanilla by deepslate, we are proud to be supporting them too! Tiles are after cut now when it comes to crafting.

### Grass, Dirt, and Mycelium:
These have gotten their blocks officially finished! Feel free to use them.

### Turtle Armor:
We added some new armor based on the Turtle Helmet

## Changes
### Textures
Many textures with the addition of Tiles have been either changed or moved.

### Files
Internally, this update was massive, you may notice some changes with the recipe systems. Which have gotten a major overhaul! Recipes may cause some severe slowdowns though so watch out. We hope that we can fix these issues soon.

## Removal/Deprecation
Some blocks may of been removed or deprecated. Check your world for:

Chiseled Bricks, Carved Bricks, Brick Pillars, Smooth Purpur Blocks, Polished Purpur Blocks, Chiseled Purpur Blocks, Carved Stone Bricks, Stone Brick Pillars, Mossy Stone Brick Pillars, Cracked Stone Brick Pillars, Mossy Chiseled Stone Bricks, Cracked Chiseled Stone Bricks, and End Stone Brick Pillars

# Progress Report:
Heres another major progress report!

## New Members:
The attentive in the discord may of noticed a few new project devs. Introducing Emmaffle and AndrewIsntCool. We are glad to have their talent on our team, and we could love to use yours! If you are interested, join our discord at: https://discord.gg/5cuHY7bYFk

## Whats next:
What we have up next will be very exciting, and we hope to show it to you, more info will come out in the following days.

And thats all we have for now! I hope to see you for our next update!
